allocation.timing_exclusion: Timing parents excluded from every science bank, fit and checkpoint selection forever.

blockers: Exact original row/ordinary-sibling inventory and both-stratum counts are unavailable in the admitted metadata; R30 explicitly defers row totals.
Exact COV missing-action inventory, count U and inventory hash cannot be derived from life IDs or payload hashes. U is unknown, not zero; the 46,080 ceiling cannot be assessed.

Original per-origin environment/numeric-library/RNG/config/ordered-roster identities and the applicable frozen cross-platform tie-classification rule are unresolved; source pins alone do not instantiate these.

Complete external seed/ultimate-ancestry/alias audit coverage is unresolved, including a lawful metadata mirror for prohibited study allocations and all prior development/validation/probe/strict/serving/R30 allocations. No accepted bank is asserted.

corpus.ordinary_sibling_scope: Retain original ordinary rows from eligible training parents under the original F4 conversion. The 960 selected rescue lives alone do not enumerate those rows or sibling lives.

row_metadata_evidence.reason: bound allocation has life metadata only; no payload opened
